question: For every one of the 67 denominator-visible lexical candidates, what exact issue, comment, timeline, linked-PR, merge-commit, current-main-presence, named-artifact, and next-adjudication route can be bound without assigning scientific success from prose or administrative state?

forbidden_paths_and_classes: existing issue bodies or comments except the final coordination comment
P1 finalizer, Slurm, LUNARC, custody, integrity, and immutable-OID paths
required_development_atoms: merged commit ancestry against frozen base main
current-main artifact presence versus branch-only evidence
common-core grouping without administrative mass closure

pagination_rules: Fetch every issue comment page and every timeline page until Link rel=next is absent.
Retain raw response bytes, selected response headers, request URL, status, byte count, and SHA-256.
Record API rate-limit censorship or unstable issue revision as a typed negative terminal.
Do not infer a PR link merely because an issue number occurs in unrelated prose.
binding_rules: One row is required for every one of the 67 intake issue numbers.
Issue title/body identity must bind the census body SHA-256; later drift is recorded as a successor snapshot, not silently substituted.
Comments and timeline events are acquisition evidence, not scientific truth.
A PR is linked only through an explicit issue/PR relationship, exact URL/reference with context, closing reference, cross-reference event, or a retained CANNOT_CHECK route.
Every merge commit must be checked for ancestry in frozen base main and current remote main separately.
Branch-only or unmerged result paths cannot be classified as current-main evidence.
No row may receive PROVEN, FORMALLY_CHECKED, COMPUTATIONALLY_GREEN_BOUNDED, or any other final scientific disposition in this identity-binding tranche.
Lexical false positives remain rows with an explicit direct-denominator exclusion reason.
Coordination/publication rows remain dependency gates and cannot absorb the disposition of child scientific issues.

row_requirements: issue number, title, body SHA-256, acquisition update time and current update time
complete comment and timeline page identities
semantic intake class and common-core id
explicit linked PRs, PR state, head/base identities and merge commits
named result/artifact paths and current-main presence state
identity status and next adjudication route

negative_controls: remove one of the 67 issue rows
replace an issue body with same-length different bytes
truncate a comment or timeline page
treat a pull request as an issue
accept a lexical issue-number mention as a linked PR without context
treat a merged PR whose merge commit is absent from main as current-main authority
assign a final scientific disposition from issue prose or checkbox state
drop #632 or #1366 instead of retaining explicit lexical-false-positive rows
transfer source quantum authority to a discovery or publication consumer
